title: WebhookInput
description: Expected payload shape from the helpdesk when a new ticket arrives. This is the input contract — synthetic test tickets must match this shape.

ticket_id.description: Helpdesk's unique identifier for this ticket. Format depends on helpdesk (e.g. 'TH-2026-04321').

body.description: Full body text of the ticket. May contain newlines, mixed languages, and PII.

sender_email.description: Email address of the person who filed the ticket.

sender_name.description: Name of the sender if provided. Optional in payload — but kept here for completeness.

customer_id.description: Foreign key to the helpdesk's customer record.

customer_type.description: B2C private individual or B2B business customer (e.g. Hausverwaltung). Used for tier weighting and governance scoping.

customer_tier.description: Customer importance tier from the helpdesk's CRM. A = strategic/high-value, B = standard, C = low-volume. Used as deterministic multiplier in priority calculation.

received_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the helpdesk received the ticket.

channel.description: Channel through which the ticket arrived.
